notes.title: Full Release! Now Available for Play!
notes.content:
Hello! This is Buff Studio.

We are excited to announce the official release of .

🎉 Full Release on 10/22 (KST)🎉
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056989/e98417f6c021c257b61987a200e074842ac05aa1.png

In the official release version, you can enjoy 7 stages and an infinite mode, along with a storyline where you can resurrect the Demon King!

Thank you for all the attention and feedback since the demo version. Thanks to your input, Skel Dungeon has become even more fun!

If you’re eager to create your own dungeon and trap heroes, start playing Skel Dungeon now!

🎁[Play the Official Release Version]

notes.title: NEXT FEST EVENT!
notes.content:
[SKEL DUNGEON Next Fest Information]
The DEMO version of Skeleton Dungeon is now available for free.
In the DEMO version, you can enjoy a total of 3 main stages.
Don't miss the event being held alongside the DEMO release!

💌[Next Fest Event Information]💌
Thank you for enjoying the demo version.
With your support, we'd like to organize additional events.

🎈Event Period
October 14, 2024 ~ October 20, 2024

🎉Winners Announcement
October 22, 2024

🎫How to Participate
1. Add Skeleton Dungeon DEMO version to your wishlist.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056989/8218160a2d1416db4277f0a3ac59003203c1c41f.gif

2. Play the Skeleton Dungeon DEMO version and leave a review.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056989/4a25d5601d6a1404261e95d15a8883ba105fcfa0.png

3. Submit proof via the Google Form below.
Link : https://forms.gle/WdQv9S5njr94eqUQ9

🎁Event Rewards
30 winners will be randomly selected to receive a Steam key for the full version of Skeleton Dungeon.
*All participants will be entered into the random drawing.

Additional Information:
- Winners will be contacted via the email submitted in the Google Form.
- Incorrect information in the Google Form may result in difficulty receiving the reward.
- Rewards will be distributed sequentially after the official release of the full version.

If you enjoy the DEMO version, stay tuned for the full release!
Thank you!
